foundation.question_text:
Write the $x$- and $y$-intercepts of the line shown.
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}\begin{axis}[width=6cm,height=5.4cm,axis lines=middle,axis line style={-{Stealth}},xmin=-2,xmax=5,ymin=-2,ymax=7,xtick={-2,-1,0,1,2,3,4,5},ytick={-2,0,2,4,6},grid=both,clip=false,scaled ticks=false,ticklabel style={font=\small,/pgf/number format/fixed},xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$}]\addplot[thick,<->,domain=-0.4:3.7,samples=2] {-2*x+6};\end{axis}\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
foundation.solution_text:
The line meets the $x$-axis at $x=3$ and the $y$-axis at $y=6$.
$x$-intercept: $(3,0)$
$y$-intercept: $(0,6)$

[/tikz]
